name: DIY Thai Coconut Curry With Shrimp Instant Noodles

ingredients.name: high-quality chicken base, such as Better Than Bouillon

instructions.primary_message: Divide chicken base, sugar, curry paste, chile-garlic sauce, fish sauce, shrimp, mushrooms, coconut milk, and noodles between 4 resealable glass jars. Divide scallions and lime wedges between 4 small zipper-lock bags and seal bags, squeezing out all of the air. Tuck bags into jars and seal. Refrigerate for up to 4 days.
When ready to serve, remove scallion packet and add boiling water to the top of the jar. Seal jar and let sit 2 minutes. Open jar, stir in scallions, squeeze with lime, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: easy, lunch, mushroom, noodle, quick, ramen, shrimp, soup

description: This pot of noodles with Thai coconut curry and fresh shrimp can be made ahead and taken to work. Just add boiling water, seal it up for three minutes, add the contents of the enclosed homemade flavor packet, and you've got a hot lunch ready.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 4 days 10 min.

Optional substitutions: button mushrooms, thinly sliced → shiitake mushrooms; nests rice noodles → pre-cooked ramen pasta or Italian pasta

Notes: Red curry paste can be found in the Asian section of most supermarkets. I prefer Mae Ploy. Dry Thai or Vietnamese rice noodles can be used with no prep. Alternatively, use precooked and chilled ramen-style noodles or fresh Italian pasta. Cook the fresh noodles in boiling water for 1 minute, shock in cold water, drain well, toss with 2 teaspoons oil until coated, then proceed with step 1.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
